html:
Blender alpha.6 tab visual refinement — October 16, 2026

The first alpha.5 layout did not match the supplied reference closely enough: the logo was left-aligned, status controls were compact, and the transfer section repeated its title inside the native Blender panel. Alpha.6 corrects those differences with a centered, larger logo above ForgeMCP and its version, a taller bridge action button, one transfer heading, and individual X/Y/Z placement rows.

The layout uses Blender's native panel and UILayout controls. These respect the active Blender theme and cannot provide arbitrary CSS backgrounds, gradients, or per-widget button colors. The card hierarchy, logo placement, information order, and control proportions follow the reference; exact pixel styling is not available through this native UI layer.

The transfer behavior is unchanged: default asset folder /Game/Content/Returns/, reviewed preview before confirmation, and cancellation before apply. The user's open scene is the default startup scene with two default objects and no active object. No scene changes were made.

Validation uses Blender 5.2.2 LTS:

  • Headless draw probe covers the centered logo, connection status, transfer settings, X/Y/Z placement fields and default destination.
  • Existing clean-profile package validation passes.
  • The installed alpha.5 Blender session is still open and has the add-on loaded in memory. Updating the installed alpha.6 files does not live-reload that Python module; the user must reload the add-on or restart Blender to see this pass.
